title: Forsaken (FCP 2026)
synopsis: Samuel Paty, a middle school teacher, uses cartoons with caricatures of the Prophet to teach freedom of expression. When a girl falsely claims she was expelled for objecting, her outraged father’s viral reaction video ignites a firestorm. While tensions escalate, an Islamist activist leaks the teacher’s personal information, and a Chechen jihadist follows the online trail to the school gates. In the aftermath, conflicting voices confront how rumour and collective inaction can lead to irreparable harm.

synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 中學教師 Samuel Paty 在課堂上利用諷刺伊斯蘭教先知的漫畫來教導言論自由; 其後，他的女學生謊稱自己因反對老師而被逐出課堂，使她憤怒的父親在網上發布短片，並迅速瘋傳，引發軒然大波。隨着緊張局勢升溫，有伊斯蘭主義活躍分子洩露了該教師的個人資料，而某位車臣聖戰分子則沿着網上留下的線索追蹤至學校門口。事後，各種互相矛盾的說法彼此交鋒，探討謠言與集體坐視不理如何導致無法挽回的後果。

cast: Antoine Reinartz, Emmanuelle Bercot, Emma Boumali, Nedjim Bouizzou
